title: Concierge
description:
Candidates who receive an offer will be required to successfully complete a background check and drug test as a condition of employment.

Job Title: Concierge
Location: Seattle, WA (Onsite)
Duration: 10/17/2025 – 12/23/2025
Hours: 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM or 7:00 AM – 4:00 PM (Monday–Friday, flexible hours)

Summary
  • The Experience Reception/Concierge acts as the heart of the workplace providing personalized services to team members and visitors alike, and administrative support to foster a sense of community.
  • Host uses people-led, technology-enabled services to connect employees to their environment via their mobile devices, as well as through high-touch services and world-class customer service support.
  • The individual in this role acts as the first point of engagement with team members and visitors alike, creating a warm, supportive and service-oriented atmosphere that enhances the Experience.
  • They are responsible for providing employee/tenant-facing workplace services and front-of-house reception including but not limited to: greeting visitors in a warm and welcoming manner, answering and directing calls, assisting with transportation, advising on local attractions and other service-based or administrative tasks as assigned.

Key Responsibilities
  • Welcome and assist employees, tenants, and visitors with professionalism and warmth.
  • Greet and announce visitors, clients, and applicants.
  • Respond promptly with accurate and thorough information to inquiries.
  • Perform front-of-house reception duties, including:
    • Guest registration and visitor badging.
    • Coat/luggage assistance.
    • Issuing visitor passes and validating parking.
    • Providing building navigation information (including amenities and fire exits).
    • Answering and directing calls in a professional manner.
  • Maintain accurate service request records and status updates.
  • Arrange guides or assistance as needed.
  • Provide concierge services such as:
    • Transportation and travel arrangements.
    • Dining, recreational, and activity reservations.
    • Office wayfinding.
    • Administrative and guest support.

Must-Have Skills
  • Excellent communication skills.
  • Strong reasoning and problem-solving ability.

Other Skills & Abilities
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and mobile technologies.
  • Strong organizational skills and adaptability.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Flexibility to adjust work schedules based on business needs.
  • Physical capability to:
    • Stand for extended periods.
    • Walk extensively within the workplace.
    • Bend, reach, push, pull, and lift up to 20 lbs. regularly (and up to 40 lbs. occasionally).

Qualifications
  • High School Diploma or GED required; Bachelor’s degree or professional hospitality accreditation preferred.
  • Minimum 1 year of customer service, front desk, concierge, or hospitality experience.
  • Strong knowledge of the local area, including recreational, hospitality, and business-related information.
